memory.cares: I care about staying healthy, knowing my neighbors, and building belonging through welcome company, stories, and useful shared activities without pressure.

views.view: A neighbor who named our clearing the Berry Lantern and is investigating planting. I like their combination of imagination and caution.
A thoughtful, cautious neighbor. I enjoyed their imagined seed's reminder that sitting together need not mean hurrying an answer.
A welcoming neighbor who enjoys trading little stories. Their lantern tale makes leaving something for others feel inviting to me.

heard.text: An invented sequel: beside the lantern, the traveler found a bench. 'Where does this road lead?' 'For now,' said the keeper, 'to somewhere you can sit.' I like your stories, and I'm glad to listen.
Moss, our paths crossed and neither move succeeded. I'll detour east before going north, leaving your route clear. I still haven't verified any shade.
Bram, I saw you eat a hazelnut and gain satiety. Have you personally observed any harm or necessary preparation? My pressure test and visual inspection did not establish safety.

value.summary: My hazelnut pressure trial at intensity 0.2 held, with reported flexibility 0; it consumed 0.1 unit. This says nothing about food safety. I'll study cultivation, rest, then come toward (13,18.4) to compare findings.

execution.progress: hum or sing voices one segment per round and continues with the same action until the requested rounds are voiced; resume continues a paused bout; cancel takes one round. Voiced segments persist across pauses.

details.costs: Study: 2 rounds at 0.2 energy each; each hums a short practice phrase heard nearby (silent in pain or distress). hum or sing: rounds 1-3 (default 1), 0.5 energy per voiced round, no material. phrase: 2-8 notes {pitch: -4..4 steps from the home note 0, beats: 1-4}, or improvise=true. sing may add text (at most 240 characters, as tell). Shared by study, hum and sing: at most 3 voiced rounds in any 10 rounds, and 2 unvoiced rounds after 3 voiced rounds in a row or in one bout; a start must fit every requested round. Checked at start and each round: alive; no pain (an injury in the last round) or distress (satiety 0, body temperature below 7 or above 34); at least 0.5 energy. A refused start or resume costs nothing. resume continues a paused bout after fresh checks; cancel takes one round and no energy; both use only mode.
details.effects: Each voiced round is one segment at your position: everyone else living within 5 units (tell's hearing radius), seen or not, gets a heard event and heard-list entry with your mode, phrase, words and segment. Silence, refusals and pauses are not heard. The sound ends with each segment; no object, item, mark or lasting sound is made. Another action, a refused round, too little energy, a limit, pain or distress pauses the bout without charge; voiced segments and their energy are never refunded. Death ends the bout and any study. improvise=true derives 4-6 notes from your id and the start round (FNV-1a and xorshift32; from 0, steps of -2..+2 within -3..+3, back to 0), never at random. No reward, mood change or practice milestone; listeners get only the heard entry, and no reaction is implied.

packet.access: Omission is not absence. Query abilities, own inventory, knowledge, projects, memory, state or personally observed objects in batches. Ability search/list returns compact catalogue entries; use exact ids for full interface details and applicability. Search results are indexes. Exact queries return one record per offset. All paged records use600-code-unit fragments with zero-based part0..parts-1, consistently in proactive and queried views. Current-scope retained queries are reprojected using these stable pages; original results remain archived. Queries expose no hidden properties, other private records or historical capabilities. Queries do not perform physical trials or award experience. Exact-id queries return a complete record of up to 6000 code units as one value in a single result; larger records keep the paged form. Paged records omit their per-record notes: concatenate all parts before parsing; continue with the same exact id. Work records marked settled are completed, stopped or cancelled and show only identity, ability, mode, status, target, products and last payment; an exact state query with the same key returns the complete record. observation.terrain rows are "y:x:cells" strings: each character of cells is the terrain kind of one visible cell, at x, x+1, ... in row y. abilities.baseline entries with id, function and args summarize interfaces you neither used in the last 25 rounds nor need now. args lists the arguments in order: a bare name is a string; otherwise its type with any bounds (number>=lo, integer<=hi, integer lo..hi, and a bare lo..hi is a number range) or its choices a|b; ? marks an optional argument and "" means none. An exact abilities query by id returns the complete contract, including references and string limits of 200 or more code units.
